newsitem.title: USA: Puget Energy, Duke/Louis Dreyfus in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Puget Energy, Duke/Louis Dreyfus in joint venture.

text.p: Puget Sound Energy and Duke/Louis Dreyfus announced Monday formation of a new company to broker electricity and natural gas over a five-state area in the U.S. Northwest.
The new company, called Duke/Louis Dreyfus-Puget Energy Services, LLC, is a 50/50 joint venture that will be headquartered in or near Seattle, Washington.
Duke/Louis Dreyfus is a joint venture between North Carolina's Duke Power Co and Louis Dreyfus Co.
Puget Sound Energy, based in Bellevue, Wash., was formed last month by the merger of Puget Sound Power & Light Co and Washington Energy Co.
The new venture, DLD-Puget Energy, will serve as a broker of electric power, natural gas and related services to utilities and retail energy users in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana and Wyoming.
It will also provide a wide range of energy-related services to end-use customers, such as energy efficiency, fuel options, engineering, and technical support.

In late 1996, Puget Sound Energy and Duke/Louis Dreyfus (DLD) entered into an advisory agreement in which DLD would work for several years with Puget on the management of its generation resources and wholesale power supply arrangements.
Under the agreement, DLD is assisting Puget Sound Energy in developing trading and risk management policies and strategies as well as energy trading systems and support.
